theorems.statement: ∀ (L : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup L] [NormedSpace ℝ L] [FiniteDimensional ℝ L], ∃ (N : ℕ) (b : Fin N → L) (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ (f : L → ℝ) (m : ℝ), IsLinearMap ℝ f → 0 ≤ m → (∀ r, |f (b r)| ≤ m) → ∀ P, |f P| ≤ C * m * ‖P‖) ∧ ∀ (β : L → L → ℝ) (m : ℝ), (∀ P, IsLinearMap ℝ (fun Q => β Q P)) → (∀ Q, IsLinearMap ℝ (β Q)) → 0 ≤ m → (∀ r t, |β (b r) (b t)| ≤ m) → ∀ Q P, |β Q P| ≤ C * m * ‖Q‖ * ‖P‖
